bootNote: The browser downloads the engine on first use and caches it for later visits. Rendering happens in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.
notes: This page runs ChartForgeX compiled to WebAssembly. The .NET snippet renders the same markup with the same native engine.
ChartForgeX markup is Markdown with chartforgex fences. Mermaid fences inside a markup document render too, so one document can hold charts, tables, flows and diagrams.
Chart options edit the markup, which a copied link and the .NET snippet preserve. A copied link also carries the preview theme; set that theme explicitly in a .NET application.
Supported ZenUML, Agentflow and Railroad source renders through native diagram owners. The Mermaid support matrix records grammar and layout limits; unsupported constructs retain located diagnostics.
